qualification_scope.database: Real disposable PostgreSQL, forced RLS, non-owner roles, physically separate encrypted write-intent journal, replay and ambiguous-response protection.
qualification_scope.providers: Synthetic IndexNow and key-file responses behind actual shared egress; real TLS OpenBao CAS and scoped ACL checks. No live IndexNow or key GitHub PR.
qualification_scope.sandbox: Real non-root no-network static-output build; exactly one root key file with exact key bytes. Existing reviewed recipe and Inbox authorization; no technical A2 enlargement.
qualification_scope.retry: Definite 429/5xx through bounded outbox attempts; terminal/replayed operations do no additional POST. Ambiguous outcomes are not retried.
qualification_scope.negative_paths: Wrong host/origin/method/body/size, missing/mismatched/type/redirect keys, unverified site, revoked/current authority, cross-tenant/site/role, retired generation and restored-primary replay.
qualification_scope.cleanup: Invocation-owned lab containers and synthetic local preview stopped; unrelated tracks' resources preserved.

ui_verification.scope: Actual DashboardView SSR and CSS, labelled synthetic fixtures, no provider capability; not authenticated production qualification.

development_corrections: Migration head and forced-RLS table-count assertions were updated from 0060/103 to 0065/116; all original safety assertions remain.
Initial page-attempt Docker provisioning failed before tests; the unchanged runner retried successfully without touching other tracks' containers.

Focused lab corrections covered exact crawl-frontier key leases, fixture media classification, fresh MFA, consistent independent journal keys and unambiguous receipt conflict handling. No safety gate was weakened.

Three gitleaks false positives were public SQL error-code literals. Equivalent scalar parentheses disambiguate them; main's allowlist is unchanged. Every full-gate command then passed again against final frozen code.
operational_limits: Internal dispatch and recipe-sealing entrypoints only: deployed poller and public key-create action remain unavailable; unconfigured owner API explicitly returns unavailable.
Current 0085 verified static-homepage coverage only; no historical backfill or unchanged-URL bulk notification.
Authoritative key storage is OpenBao. The reviewed public key-file patch and exact public key URL in egress metadata necessarily contain the publication bytes.
Rotation retires the old generation when the new proposal is sealed; no deletion or merge/deploy authority is added.
Live IndexNow, live key-file GitHub PR, customer deployment, certified delivery and production worker composition are NOT_EXECUTED.
